titleByLocale.it: Mutual Fund Core Processing Specialista - US Shift
titleByLocale.de: Mutual Fund Core Processing Spezialist - US Shift
titleByLocale.fr: Mutual Fund Core Processing Spécialiste - US Shift

jobs.description:
Are you incredibly organized with an eye for detail? Do you know how to take care of business?

We are looking for someone like that who can

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Mutual Fund Core Specialist to join our operations team. This role is responsible for all operational aspects of mutual fund processing while supporting key functions that ensure accuracy and timeliness in trade execution. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, excellent communication abilities, and a collaborative mindset to work across internal teams and external parties.

Key 
• Responsibilities:

Trade Execution & Processing

Assist in entering mutual fund trades into internal systems with precision and speed.

Confirm trade eligibility based on fund rules, account setup, and compliance guidelines.

Monitor trade activity throughout the day to ensure timely execution and settlement.

Support wire entry and ensure proper routing of funds to meet trade settlement deadlines.

Reconciliation & Issue Resolution

Reconcile mutual fund positions and transactions daily at both the CUSIP and account level.

Identify and resolve breaks or discrepancies in trade data, escalating issues when needed.

Collaborate with internal teams (operations, technology, compliance) to troubleshoot and resolve trade-related issues.

Communication & Collaboration

Interact with fund companies, custodians, and counterparties to clarify trade details and resolve exceptions.

Maintain clear and professional communication across departments to support smooth trade processing.

Support audits, internal controls, and process improvement initiatives related to reconciliation and transfer processes.

Document procedures and contribute to training materials for both onshore and offshore teams.

• •support senior bankers in anticipating client priorities, executing against live opportunities and working seamlessly with internal and external stakeholders
•build and maintain rigorous financial and valuation models across live transactions and strategic assignments, including M&A, IPOs, follow-ons, private capital raising and other real estate, lodging and leisure corporate finance situations
•identify key issues early, assess alternatives with sound judgement and help drive practical, well-reasoned solutions under tight timelines

jobs.title: Product Owner – Digital Capabilities
jobs.description:
Do you have an entrepreneurial mindset and are you eager to understand and fulfill our clients’ needs? Do you want to play a key role in transforming our firm into an agile organization?

At UBS, we re-imagine the way we work, the way we connect with each other – our colleagues, clients and partners – and the way we deliver value. Being agile will make us more responsive, more adaptable, and ultimately more innovative.

We’re looking for a Product Owner to:

• Develop and maintain a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap for building out our digital platform solutions
• Define and maintain Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) aligned to product and business strategy
• Collaborate with end users in IB Operations to communicate art of the possible and identify business processes that require transformation and migration onto new platforms
• Assess potential use cases objectively and understand business value vs cost of solution, looking to reuse or extend existing capabilities where feasible
• Influence the design of new solutions to deliver benefit for multiple stakeholders where possible
• Maintain pod and iteration backlogs in Gitlab to a high standard
• Assist with relevant data sourcing, ensuring compliance with the firms policies
• Obtain necessary governance approvals for new use cases / solutions
• Mitigate impediments to the team’s goals, align across pods and with other crews where needed and act as your pod’s ambassadors towards internal stakeholders and clients

jobs.title: Sustainability Controller
jobs.description:
Would you like to make an impact on our Group’s sustainability governance and controls? Are you passionate about sustainability and ESG topics?
We’re looking for a Sustainability Controller like you to:
• enhance the governance framework over our Group's sustainability disclosures and reporting. This includes defining the governance process, timelines and documentation and control standards for metric owners and disclosure owners, as well as challenging and approving proposed metrics to ensure disclosures are fit for purpose
• act as a SME on various sustainability reporting topics. Be our point of contact for multiple stakeholders on matters relating to metrics, disclosures, and reporting. Coordinate with data providers to educate, enhance, and embed the control framework for sustainability reporting
• use your deep accounting and sustainability reporting knowledge to perform content and analytical reviews of our Group sustainability disclosures. Assess reporting revisions and impacts on reporting.
• support assurance activities over sustainability reporting. Act as an interface between auditors and internal stakeholders
• define, conduct and review metric reporting risk assessments
• integrate new ESG regulatory requirements and/or standards into business as usual.

jobs.title: Rates and FX Valuation Controller
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about the financial markets? Are you an innovator who loves to solve problems? We are looking for someone to use their expertise and join UBS Valuation Control Group in Mumbai

• responsible to review & perform the independent price testing (ipv) of fair valued assets & liabilities in the rates and fx ; products include bonds, swaps, swaptions, bermudans, fx options etc.
• computation & reporting of reserves for the rates and fx business
• discuss & agree with desk, finance and valuation methodology teams on product valuation, month end ipv adjustments & reserve numbers
• review & perform prudential valuation calculation for the fair valued positions in the rates business
• review of monthly valuation packs along with commentaries explaining the reserves & ipv numbers
• on a continuous basis review/challenge client needs and prepare reports in standardized format, with adhoc reports and analysis for senior management
• represent the team during internal & external audits, running the auditors through the different processes in detail & resolving their queries

jobs.description:
We are looking for a professional, degree-educated Executive Assistant with at least five years’ experience supporting at C-suite / senior level within the international financial industry to support the Country Head of Italy.

• a small amount of personal admin will also be required.

• support preparation of real estate capital gains tax statements
• support real estate tax processes
• support direct tax and administrative tasks (e.g., supporting documents, data preparation)
• support continuous improvement of VAT processes and controls

jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working with numbers and keeping things running smoothly? As an Accounting & Reporting Specialist, you will support periodic closings/reporting, ensure high-quality data, and help deliver analyses, controls, and cash flow reviews. In this role, you will support daily tasks while actively contributing to ongoing process improvements.

We’re looking for an Accounting & Reporting Specialist to support the team with the following responsibilities:

• accounting support and administration for various products (real estate funds, investment groups, mandates), including coordination with internal stakeholders
• create, review, and prepare analyses of key figures and statistics
• review cash flow statements and support liquidity planning
• perform control activities (e.g., completeness and plausibility checks, reconciliations, four-eyes controls) and document the results
• maintain and ensure the quality of data/baselines (e.g., master data, reporting parameters) in the relevant systems
• support periodic closings/reporting (monthly/quarterly/annually) and ad-hoc analyses
• contribute to process improvements and automation in the reporting and control environment

jobs.title: Investment Analytics & Automation Analyst – ETFs
jobs.description:
Are you interested in working in the fastest growing area of passive investments?
Are you highly motivated by financial markets and portfolio construction?
Do you enjoy working in a high performing, diverse and international team?
Do you have a flair for numbers and presenting to stakeholders and clients? Then this is the role for you!

UBS Asset Management is seeking an Investment Analytics & Automation Analyst – ETFs to join the ETF & Index Fund business which is one of the key growth areas of the company.
Index tracking investment solutions have been a core competence of UBS Asset Management for over 30 years.

Key tasks:
• monthly Analytics deliverables which requires running reports,
• maintaining and updating collateral material,
• performing in-depth analysis on products and competitor offerings,
• clearly articulate and present the findings of the analysis to internal,
• strong MS Office skills, in particular Excel and PowerPoint,
• programming skills, with R coding skills being highly advantageous,
• motivated to enhance and automate processes involving data and displaying results in reports and presentations,
• having a positive attitude and willingness to learn and contribute to a high-performance team.

You will be supporting the ETF & Index Fund Investment Analytics team

UBS has a long track record of specialising in a quality indexing approach, which has contributed to them being one of the fastest growing index managers globally. Assets under management across index strategies amount to more than USD 1tn and USD 170bn in ETFs (as at Q4 25).

• Perform high-quality and high-integrity Cyber and Information Security technical risk assessments, root cause analysis and risk investigations on IT and Cloud architectures, infrastructures, platforms, applications, technology stacks and business projects, based on current cyber threats landscape and emerging risks.

Your role

Are you incredibly organized with an eye for detail? Do you know how to take care of business?

We are looking for an Operations Specialist who will be responsible for end-to-end processing of paper and electronic check items cleared through the Federal Reserve, including posting adjustments, researching discrepancies, and processing Fed returns. This role ensures timely, accurate settlement and strict compliance with Federal Reserve, Reg CC, and internal bank policies.

Key Responsibilities:
• Investigate and resolve client inquiries related to payment issues, including sanctions holds, returned funds, and payment cancellations.
• Monitor and manage payment queues, ensuring timely resolution of flagged or delayed transactions.
• Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., Compliance, Operations, Risk) to resolve complex cases and escalate issues when necessary.
• Maintain accurate records of investigations and resolutions in accordance with regulatory and internal standards.
• Identify trends or recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
• Support audit and compliance reviews by providing documentation and insights into investigation processes.

• Maintain accurate records of investigations and resolutions in accordance with regulatory and internal standards.
• Identify trends or recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
• Support audit and compliance reviews by providing documentation and insights into investigation processes.

• •responsibility to lead local regulatory and audit exams, representing GB BRM
• •build strong relationships with Global Banking senior management and control partners, and present at relevant governance forums

jobs.title: UGM Business Manager
jobs.description:
Do you thrive in fast-paced, front-office environments where execution and collaboration drive results? Are you passionate about scaling businesses, improving efficiency, and enabling revenue growth?

We’re seeking a Business Manager to join the Unified Global Markets (UGM) COO team, supporting senior leadership across Sales and Trading to deliver strategic initiatives that enhance business performance and client outcomes. In this role, you’ll work side-by-side with front-office team members to streamline processes, scale the platform, and drive commercial momentum across asset classes.

You’ll act as a trusted partner to senior business heads – connecting strategic objectives with day-to-day execution, and helping shape how UGM grows and competes across the Americas

• •partner with members of the COO team and senior business leaders to execute strategic priorities that support growth, efficiency, and scalability across Sales and Trading
• •identify and drive front-to-back process improvements to enhance productivity, client responsiveness, and execution quality
• •support commercial initiatives to optimize the client experience, improve sales coverage models, and unlock new revenue opportunities
• •deliver data-driven insights to help leadership measure performance and make informed decisions
• •lead or coordinate cross-functional projects across Trading, Sales, COO, Finance, Operations, and Technology teams
• •anticipate business needs and proactively design solutions that improve speed to-market, platform scalability, and front-office efficiency
• •maintain awareness of operational and regulatory frameworks, ensuring strategic execution remains sound and sustainable

jobs.title: Director, FX Options Trader
jobs.description:
UBS Business Solutions US LLC is seeking a Director, FX Options Trader in New York, NY
Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms?

We’re looking for a Director, FX Options Trader to:
• Provide market-making and risk management for all Foreign Exchange (FX) Options emerging market currency pairs to the UBS client franchise utilizing specialized knowledge of internally developed tools and systems, including Market Maker Gui, FX Cockpit, Thor, Levitas and Brokertron.
• Focus on specialized field of knowledge in FX Options emerging markets currency to maintain accurate volatility surfaces across all the currency pairs by considering client flows and interbank market trades. Manage client flow risks and inventory positions.
• Leverage advanced knowledge of Market Maker Gui and Bloomberg to produce regular trade ideas and market updates, build and manage relationships with clients and prospective clients. Engage in FX Options initiatives to increase the UBS footprint in the U.S. market with a focus on Latin America, and partner with Sales and Strategy teams within Global Markets to capitalize on FX Options opportunities within the U.S.
• Apply expert understanding of specialized knowledge of our internally developed tools including T-Pricer and Market Maker Gui to improve the UBS E-trading offering to our U.S. clients via customized pricing profiles and enhanced technology in FX Options emerging markets currency pairs.
• Support the FX Options Trading division to efficiently and effectively run business operations, while maintaining responsibility for over 50 FX Options volatility surfaces.

Qualified Applicants apply through SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Please reference 001684. NO CALLS PLEASE. EOE/M/F/D/V

jobs.description:
UBS Securities LLC is seeking an Associate Director, Global Markets Quantitative Analyst in New York, NY
Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms?

We’re looking for an Associate Director, Global Markets Quantitative Analyst to:
• Develop and maintain sophisticated decision-making system at scale. Develop and support large scale real-time trading risk monitoring system to support multi-asset risk management within global markets.
• Build out scenario analytical platform to support risk management of portfolios and client margin management. Build scalable solutions to identify opportunities for prime brokerage, Delta 1 trading, inventory management, funding, lending and collateral optimization.
• Engage and understand balance sheet and risk requirements and/or controls. Lead technology design discussions for scalability and performance.
• Can work hybrid (In-office/remote).

• Chairing and preparing minutes for the local Risk Management Control Committee and attending monthly management meetings.
• Oversight and submission of regulatory reporting.
• Management of local liquidity risk management guidelines, involvement in the semi-annual liquidity stress test.
• Oversight of the monthly credit stress test.
• Internal/Regulatory inquiries related to Korea Risk in general.

We're looking for someone like this to:
– negotiate the document framework of master agreements for trading financial products, including prime brokerage, custody, OTC derivatives (ISDA and CSA), exchange traded derivatives, repo (GMRA) and securities financing (GMSLA/AMSLA)
– stay up to date with relevant trading financial products documentation developments to make sure we meet all obligations to our customers and regulators

jobs.title: Client Account Manager APAC Switzerland
jobs.description:
Are you curious, proactive and always striving to bring positive impact to clients?

We’re looking for a WM Client Account Manager to:
• support client advisors in delivering exceptional client service and experience
• support client advisors in administrative, risk and legal and compliance related tasks and duties
• manage daily business in WM HNW/UHNW client servicing and provide high quality service
• be the point of entry for processing client orders, e.g. stock orders, foreign exchange, loans and deposits
• be the direct contact for daily banking activities and administrative work for our clients
• manage daily client transactions and carry out inquiries and troubleshooting
• perform account maintenance tasks and client-related processes; e.g. account opening and closing, suitability reviews, initial and recurring KYC and due diligence
• support client advisors when they are on business trips and assist in preparing client meetings
